title: Marketing Executive
description:
PIX Transmission Ltd PIX Transmissions Ltd. is the leading manufacturer of Belts and related mechanical Power Transmission products globally. The Company features state-of-the-art Belt manufacturing units as well as an ultra-sophisticated, automated Rubber Mixing facility. PIX Transmissions Ltd. enjoys significant brand equity in the Power Transmissions industry, with strong local as well global presence. The company has overseas subsidiary operations in Europe, and the Middle-East, in addition to over 250 committed Channel Partners in over 100 countries worldwide. 
 Website http://www.pixtrans.com 
 Industry Rubber Products Manufacturing 
 Headquarters Nagpur, Maharashtra 
 Type Public Company 
 Founded 1981 
 Specialties Largest manufacturer of V-Belts in Asia, Manufacturer of Industrial V-Belts, Manufacturer of Agricultural Belts, Manufacturer of Lawn & Garden Belts, Manufacturer of Automotive Belts, Manufacturer of Special Construction Belts, Subsidiary operations in Europe, and the Middle-East, V Belts, Timing Belts, and Leading manufacturer of Belts and related mechanical Power Transmission products globally. 
 JOB PURPOSE :- This position is responsible for ensuring effective customer support operations including pre-shipment and post- shipment. Additionally, the roles involves promotion of the company's products and services, ensuring that the right message is communicated to attract prospective customers and retain existing ones. The marketing executive will establish marketing positioning, identify target customers and develop comprehensive marketing plans. 
 Job Location : Ludhiana 
 RESPONSIBILITY : 
 1 Conduct market research to identify customer needs, market trends and opportunities, and develop marketing strategies accordingly. 
 2 Plan, execute and oversee marketing campaigns. 
 3 Develop compelling marketing materials such as brochures, social media content and website updates. 
 4 Promote the company's products and services to enhance brand awareness and market presence. 
 5 Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and partners to foster loyalty and drive business growth. 
 6 Manage the marketing budget and maximize ROI and achieve marketing goals. 
 7 Maintain records of customer interactions, transactions inquiries, complaints and feedback. 
 8 Develop and implement customer support policies and procedures aimed at enhancing service quality and customer satisfaction. 
 9 Identify and pursue new market opportunities to increase market share and drive revenue growth. 
 10 Develop and implement lead generation strategies to attract and convert potential customers. 
 11 Proactively identify and resolve customer issues, providing timely and effective solutions. 
 12 Implement strategies to increase customer retention and loyalty, including follow-up communications and special promotions. 
 13 Track and analyze customer service metrics to identify trends and areas of improvement. 

 Please feel free to connect to Nikhil Aniwal on :_ Nikhil.Aniwal@pixtrans.com Mobile: 7798819022

title: Assistant Marketing Manager
description:
Assist the Business Development Manager in developing and implementing marketing strategies. Create and upload blog banners, posts, and guides on the company website; coordinate with the website developer for updates. Prepare eye-catching social media creatives using Canva and post weekly content across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and relevant groups. Plan, create, and publish reels and short promotional videos for Instagram and other platforms. Run and monitor email marketing campaigns using tools like Mailchimp, Vtiger, or Pipedrive, including tracking performance and unsubscribers. Coordinate with SEO vendors for monthly performance reports and ensure improvements are implemented. Manage and optimize monthly Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads campaigns while tracking leads and conversions through CRM systems. Collaborate with external vendors for newsletter designing and publishing; ensure timely release. Track overall marketing activities, maintain accurate lead data, and support the Marketing Manager with monthly performance reports. Monitor inventory of office and coordinate for the procurement of new inventory. Ensure the smooth and adequate flow of information within the company related to employee engagement activities, events & functions.

Key Skills: Marketing planning,Global marketing,US market,Management,Planning,Global Mobility,Sales And Marketing,Sales
